resources.string:
Relay traffic over UDP between tailnet devices that cannot reach each other directly, instead of a DERP server.
• Costs data: other devices' connections pass through this device.
• Used only where the tailnet's access policy grants relay use to this device (tailscale.com/cap/relay); the visual policy editor in the admin console can add that grant.
• Behind carrier NAT other devices can rarely reach this one; a fixed port forwarded on the router helps.
• The official Tailscale app for Android cannot do this; TailSocks runs its own daemon, which can. The coordination server can still turn it off for this device — this row then says so.

Send the traffic the tailnet routes through app connectors (SaaS apps, sites that admit only known addresses) out through this device\'s internet connection.\n• Needs a tag on this device and an app connector for that tag in the admin console (Apps), with access rules that allow it.\n• Costs data: that traffic goes out through this device.
Nothing is checked: the coordination server alone decides who joins. It is turned on from a trusted device with “tailscale lock init”.
